title: Tenma Saki — Most Important Wish〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, everyone! Look!
We can make wish plaques here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since we're here, we should write our wishes from earlier!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we already made our wishes. Do we really need to do this all over again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What if this doubles the chances of them coming true?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. It's a New Year tradition too so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Earlier, there were so many people standing behind me that I sort of cut it short...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you're supposed to thank the spirits for watching over you and let them know your name and where you're from.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? I never knew that, Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't tell the spirits any of that, so I better put that on the wish plaque!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold your horses! That's your personal information. Are you sure you want that to become public information?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You could just write your first name?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look, lots of other people wrote their first names on these plaques.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if the spirits mistake me for some other Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know what I'll do!
I'll draw my face next to my name!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait... Your face?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, do you really want to have your wish granted that much?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! I really, REALLY want to have it come true!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's all draw our faces on the wish plaques!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um... That's a nice idea...
But I'll pass...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. You might spook even the spirits with your art, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On the contrary, her unique style might draw their attention.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Guys, please...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey! Stop picking on Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you should do the drawing for all of us, since it was your brilliant idea.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like that, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You sure?
Okay, I'll draw you really cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Big eyes with long eyelashes...
Your hair tied like this and... Done!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, it's minimalistic but you captured her characteristics.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, wow! Thank you, Saki!
It's so cute, I feel like I owe you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You owe me nothing, Hona!
I just hope you get your wish granted too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, Saki, what did you wish for?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I'm curious to know too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. What is it that you want granted so badly?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Teehee. Okay then, are you ready?
Ta-da...! Take a look♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It says, I want to be with my besties forever!
Hehe. I guessed as much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you sure you want to go with this one? You already made this wish before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I have lots of wishes and it was a tough choice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to get better at playing the keyboard, not miss out on any of the school events by being sick and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want school, clubs, work, hanging out and everything else to be nothing but fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That is a lot of wishes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you know what? I realized that none of those things would be fun if I didn't have you guys.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So the wish I want granted most is for us to be together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Aww, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm all for that.
Let's have another fun year together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then you should make it clear when you write out your wish.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Kind spirits, make my wish come true. Pretty please!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What should we do next?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We could walk around some more and take a look at the stalls we missed. Miku and Luka will be happy to hear about everything we see!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, let's do that.
And then... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Look at all those stars!
Is that one Orion's Belt?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Where?
